description: Generalisation beyond the primary panel using the same BDCL configuration (eps=0.1, lambda_b=0.3, lambda_f=0.2)
finding: Performance degrades gracefully as the domain diverges from the consumer/FMCG context the behavioural embeddings were trained on. Pew and ESS show higher JS (0.024, 0.031) but remain within the 0.05 acceptance threshold; Twin-2K-500 lands close to the primary evaluation, confirming generalisation to persona-based tasks.
